role: The bat model: head with two ear boxes, body with the feet plate, and the four wing segments chained as child ModelRenderers, flapping or folded when hanging.
scope_reason: Bats are vanilla, in scope, and pixel-gated (out/java/render/mobs2b_bat_*).

members.name: batHead
members.note: part 0, the head yaw/pitch and the two ear boxes

members.name: batBody
members.note: part 3, body box plus the 0,34 feet plate

members.name: ModelBat
members.note: the box geometry and the parent chain (part->parent) mirror the addChild tree

members.name: getBatSize
members.note: RenderBat.doRender compares it with its renderedBatSize and rebuilds the ModelBat when they differ (always 36, so once): a model reload with nothing drawn from it; RenderBat's shadow is its constructor's 0.25

members.name: setRotationAngles
members.note: the wing flap (mh_cos(age*1.3f)*PI*0.25) and the hang pose live inside model_bat

notes: The hanging vs flying wing angles and the PI/4 body tilt match the Java setRotationAngles branches by reading both.
